    release_value = ws.cell(row=row, column=4).value  # Column D: Releases

    try:
        amount = float(release_value) if release_value not in (None, "") else 0
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        amount = 0

    if isinstance(movement_type, str) and movement_type.strip().lower() == "entrance":
        running_balance += amount
    elif isinstance(movement_type, str) and movement_type.strip().lower() == "exit":
        running_balance -= amount
    else:
        running_balance += 0

    # Store integer-looking values as ints for cleaner Excel display.
    ws.cell(row=row, column=5).value = int(running_balance) if running_balance == int(running_balance) else running_balance
